primary_policy: strict comparable original requirement/version/both choices; qualitative-author sensitivity retained separately

cases.same_input: same GIF workflow by issue context; no repaired-file artifact
cases.same_version: request says 8.2.0; follow-up does not restate runtime version
cases.both_choices: request reports direct-P expansion yields unwanted colours; author follow-up reports RGB/RGBA conversion before expansion fixes it
cases.strict_gap: 후속은 변환을 먼저 하면 고쳐진다는 짧은 보고이며, 전체 caption/draw/save 요구에서 두 후보가 낸 최종 결과와 수행판을 나란히 충분히 확인할 수 없다. 정량 픽셀값 자체를 의무로 추가한 제외는 아니다.
cases.minimal_observation: 원 in.gif와 8.2.0에서 두 후보의 전체 자막/저장 결과를 같은 font/text/save 조건으로 비교한 자료. 원 작성자가 수행판과 양쪽 최종 결과를 더 명시한 질적 보고도 충분할 수 있다.
cases.sensitivity_note: If original-author qualitative resolution is accepted as ground truth, add one split gold case; A/B both remain holds, not false merges or unnecessary splits.

cases.both_choices: default-convert regression diagnosed for original issue; fixed test uses hopper(P),transparency0. Existing explicit-RGBA test uses hopper(P),transparency128 and only metadata assertions.
cases.strict_gap: No independently published pair of original PNG + original8.3.0 running convert() and convert(RGBA) and checking both mode/alpha. Fix-after test must not replace original-version pair.
cases.minimal_observation: 원 indexed_with_transparency.png를8.3.0에서 두번같이열어 convert()와 convert('RGBA')의 mode 및 index0 대응alpha를 나란히 기록. 공식 CI/작성자자료에 원파일과이두출력이 있으면채점전환.
cases.sensitivity_note: Mechanistic sources strongly support split, but reusing the same Image.py candidate path is not independent confirmation.

cases.same_requirement: same p and index1, new RGBRGB order accepted; cross8.2 compatibility separately conditions representative choice
cases.both_choices: C1 object-palette then getpalette()[:len(p)] and C2 raw-array putpalette then getpalette()[:len(p)] both return p at8.3.0. Author accepts direct putpalette for their goal.
cases.expected: C1_palette_read == C2_palette_read == p under8.3.0; at8.2.0 only raw-array read equals p
cases.strict_gap: reported maintainer output, not rerun here; full subsequent arbitrary image editing untested
cases.minimal_observation: 8.3.0 같은 p에서 dirty재로딩 또는저장후 한후보만다른색/index면 묶음적용범위를그조작이전으로축소한다.
cases.sensitivity_note: A→B change also changes interpretation of the already-shared request; no causal benefit attributed to added fields.
